attempts.text:
Only four roads are usable: Thakre–Gajuri (7), Thakre–Myagang (24), Suryagadhi–Likhu (24) and Likhu–Panchakanya (26). These form two separate networks:
- **Reachable by car1:** Thakre shelter, Gajuri and Myagang
- **Cut off from car1:** Suryagadhi, Likhu and Panchakanya

Tarkeshwar hospital has no usable roads at all, so Thakre shelter is the only evacuation point car1 can use.

**Decisions**

| Location | People | Decision | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gajuri | 1 elderly | Rescue, 7 minutes each way | 14 driving (deferring costs 50) |
| Myagang | 1 elderly | Rescue, 24 minutes each way | 48 driving (deferring costs 50) |
| Panchakanya | 2 injured | Defer, unreachable | 160 penalty |
| Panchakanya | 1 elderly | Defer, unreachable | 50 penalty |
| Likhu | 7 adults | Defer, unreachable | 140 penalty |

**Total cost:** 62 minutes of driving + 350 in penalties = 412

The penalties for Panchakanya and Likhu can't be avoided with this car, so these 10 people, including the 2 injured, need priority in the next rescue wave. Likhu and Panchakanya can't currently reach an evacuation point by road either, so that wave will need the Tarkeshwar–Likhu bridge restored or another form of transport.

<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter gajuri-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 gajuri-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car1 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
defer panchakanya-care-home injured 2
defer panchakanya-care-home elderly 1
defer likhu-farm adult 7
</plan>

COST: 412
